text:
maya: Who's up for an after-work 'Mini-Olympics' + tapas crawl next Friday? thinking boardgames + trivia at 6:30 then tapas at 8 — rooftop weather permitting :sunny:

sam: Ooh! I'm in. Would love to bring Codenames. :heart_eyes:

jon: Count me in but can't do rooftop if it's windy :wind_face:

priya: I'm interested — vegetarian here. Also can chip in $10 for the reservation.

dave: i'm in. can we have a clear vegan option too?

nora: love this. can someone make a poll for game prefs? quick and dirty please :grin:

maya: done — react in this thread for game picks: :one: Codenames, :two: Jackbox, :three: Trivia, :four: Boardgame cafe. React to vote. Also @ops-bot can we tag this under socials budget? :eyes:

ops-bot: Please submit an expense with tag #team-socials. Example: `/expense submit --amount 10 --category team-socials --notes "Mini-Olympics tapas"`

maya: also dropping a short sheet to collect RSVPs + dietary notes: https://tiny.redwood/social-mini-olympics (pls add if you're bringing +1)

sam: RSVP +1 (bringing Samira). added. :thumbsup:

priya: added dietary note — vegetarian + gluten-free option would be ideal. thanks!

dave: put me down for vegan. also can someone check rooftop booking? heard another team booked at 7:30. :thinking:

maya: pinged facilities. if rooftop is blocked we'll move to the ground-floor lounge. :thumbsup:

facilities: Hey team — rooftop is free after 7. We can reserve 8–10pm. If you want rooftop earlier, we can try to swap. DM for keycode.

nora: sweet. volunteers for setup? i can bring napkins and cups :handshake:

alex: i'll bring a portable speaker (bluetooth). also can someone grab string lights if it's outdoors?

maya: perfect. putting volunteers list on the sheet. closing poll Wed 5pm.

jon: any chance we can start at 6:15? I've got a hard 9pm dinner reservation.

maya: noted — if majority ok i'll shift to 6:15. react with :clock630: if you prefer earlier. (jk about the emoji name)

sam: small note — if anyone's commuting late, metro has trains til midnight but check schedules. saved me once :sweat_smile:

priya: can we also set a $ cap for the tapas split? maybe $25 max?

maya: thinking $20–25 sounds fair. if you can't swing it DM me and we'll cover. :heart:

dave: thanks. i'll also coordinate vegan plates with the venue — pinging their events contact.

maya: lovely. final reminder: react for game vote, add to sheet, and submit expense if you're chipping in. excited! :tada:

nora: excited too. high five team :raised_hands:
